pr.title: fix(Salesforce Trigger Node): Stop Created triggers refiring on record updates
pr.body:
## Summary

The Salesforce Trigger's `*Created` variants (Case/Account/Contact/Lead/Opportunity/Task/User/Attachment/CustomObject) were refiring every time a freshly-created record was updated.

**Root cause:** PR #29107 changed the dedup key in `filterAndManageProcessedItems` to `${Id}_${LastModifiedDate}` for all trigger variants. Combined with the 15‑minute poll safety margin in `getPollStartDate`, a record stays in the SOQL result set for ~15 minutes after creation. If anyone edits it during that window, `LastModifiedDate` changes → the composite key looks new → the Created trigger fires again.

**Fix:** Add a `changeType` parameter to `filterAndManageProcessedItems`. `Created` variants now dedup by `Id` alone (a record is created exactly once; `LastModifiedDate` is irrelevant for dedup). `Updated` variants keep the existing composite-key behavior, so the original PR #29107 fix is preserved.

### Test plan

- Created a Salesforce Case → trigger fires once ✅
- Updated the same Case within 15 min → trigger does not refire ✅
- Updated trigger variant still fires on each modification ✅
- New unit tests in `__test__/GenericFunctions.test.ts` cover both paths
- Full `nodes/Salesforce/__test__` suite passes (138 + 21 tests)

## Related Linear tickets, Github issues, and Community forum posts

- https://linear.app/n8n/issue/NODE-5056
- fixes #30536

<details>
<summary>Architecture diagram</summary>

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant SF as Salesforce
    participant Trigger as SalesforceTrigger Node
    participant UT as Utility Functions
    participant Process as filterAndManageProcessedItems
    participant Store as processedIds Store

    Note over SF,Store: Trigger Node Polling Cycle

    loop Every Poll Interval
        Trigger->>SF: SOQL query for records
        
        alt Created Trigger Variant
            Note over Trigger,Store: changeType = 'Created'
            SF-->>Trigger: Records with Id, LastModifiedDate
            Trigger->>UT: getPollStartDate(lastTimeChecked)
            UT-->>Trigger: ISO timestamp
            Trigger->>Process: filterAndManageProcessedItems(responseData, processedIds, 'Created')
            
            Note over Process: Dedup by Id only
            Process->>Process: Build itemKey = item.Id (ignores LastModifiedDate)
            Process->>Store: Check if Id in processedIdsSet
            alt Id not in processedSet
                Process-->>Trigger: newItems includes record
                Process->>Store: Add Id to updatedProcessedIds
            else Id already processed
                Process-->>Trigger: newItems excludes duplicate
            end
            
            Trigger->>Trigger: Emit newItems as events
            Trigger->>Store: Persist updatedProcessedIds
            
        else Updated Trigger Variant
            Note over Trigger,Store: changeType = 'Updated'
            SF-->>Trigger: Records with Id, LastModifiedDate
            Trigger->>Process: filterAndManageProcessedItems(responseData, processedIds, 'Updated')
            
            Note over Process: Dedup by Id + LastModifiedDate
            Process->>Process: Build itemKey = `${Id}_${LastModifiedDate}`
            Process->>Store: Check if composite key in processedIdsSet
            alt Composite key not processed
                Process-->>Trigger: newItems includes record
                Process->>Store: Add composite key to updatedProcessedIds
            else Composite key already processed
                Process-->>Trigger: newItems excludes duplicate
            end
            
            Trigger->>Trigger: Emit newItems as events
            Trigger->>Store: Persist updatedProcessedIds
        end
    end
```
</details>

commits.message:
fix(Salesforce Trigger Node): Stop Created triggers refiring on record updates

Created-variant triggers now dedup by Id alone, while Updated variants keep
the existing Id+LastModifiedDate composite key. Previously, an update to a
record still inside the 15-minute poll safety-margin window produced a new
composite key and refired the Created trigger.
